svg.title: Launch tools DEFADE names
svg.desc: Proxima, Sumo, uxento, J7 and RapidLaunch: the launch tools a DEFADE scan names, each off a mark only its own launches leave.
svg.text: LAUNCHED WITH A BUNDLER? THE SCAN SAYS WHICH ONE.
Software that creates a token and buys it from a fleet of wallets in the same moment. A tag above the
token's name reads "launched with" and the tool, and Bundle Detection says the same.
Its own program in the launch transactions, or its rotation: a
wallet sells and the proceeds pay for another wallet's buy in the
Its launch fee: a fixed share of the supply moved from a bundle
wallet to a fresh wallet that sells it for Sumo's treasury.
Its fee wallet, paid inside the token's own create transaction. On
Ethereum, a Stroid launch naming that wallet as partner.
The token's metadata on J7's own servers. On Robinhood, a
launch sent through J7's own launch router.
The token's metadata on RapidLaunch's own servers, or a
launch made through its own launch contracts.
Never named on a guess: a tool is named off its program, its fee, its launch contract or its metadata server.
On Pro, the wallets that ran it carry its name, and wallets seen in its fleet before are flagged as known bundlers.
